title: proof-audit grades
description: One grade per requirement ID the proof auditor was given. gates/proof_audit.py checks every quote against the repository; this file is also the output schema the Codex run is held to (strict: every key required, no others).

id.description: The requirement ID exactly as given.

cases.description: Every case the requirement's wording names, each with the assertions that prove it (none for a case left unproven).

file.description: The test file's path in the repository.

test.description: The test's title exactly as written in the file.

line.description: The 1-based line number of the assertion in the file.

assertion.description: That line's whole text without its indentation, copied exactly.

plan.description: The plan file's path in the repository.

line.description: The 1-based line number of the plan line that names the other owner.

quote.description: That line's whole text without its indentation, copied exactly.

owner.description: The owner section as <plan path>#<heading anchor>.

missing.description: For UNPROVEN, each case with no proving assertion and the test that would prove it; empty otherwise.
